Vacancy for Pharmacovigilance Associate
Thursday, 29 August 2019
5113 Hits
Applications are invited for the post of Pharmacovigilance Associate (1 post) under Pharmacovigilance Programme of India project at Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences as per the following description.
Qualification
: Master’s Degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences or M.B.B.S/B.D.S/Pharm.D or equivalent
Experience
: Preference will be given to young, dynamic personnel having experience in Pharmacovigilance along with proficiency in Computer
Pay Scale
: Consolidated emolument of Rs. 25,000/- per month
The applicants should send their applications along with complete bio-data with necessary academic experience  certificates/testimonials for the above post to Dr Sushil Kumar Varma, HOD Pharmacology and AMC Co-ordinator, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram. Dist. Wardha (MS) till
28/09/2019
. The appointment shall be on contract basis.
